a: Best default for public clients: auth code with PKCE.
Implicit flow is legacy and discouraged for new apps.
Device code flow helps TVs and CLI devices without rich browsers.
Scopes limit what an access token is allowed to do.
Users approve requested scopes on the authorization server.
Verify signature, iss, aud, exp, and nbf before trusting claims.
JWKS endpoints publish public keys for verifying JWTs.
Introspection lets resource servers ask the auth server if a token is active.
DPoP sender-constrains tokens to a key to reduce bearer token theft impact.
state prevents CSRF on the redirect-based authorization flow.
